source: IFRC DREF Bulletin MDRZM003 Final Report Zambia Cholera 2006-2007
processing_notes: Source states: 'On 15 October 2006, a cholera case was officially reported at the Lukanga Fishing camp in Kapiri Mposhi district (Central province). The number of cases later increased and the situation deteriorated; by the end of November 2006, a cumulative total of 115 cases and five deaths had been recorded.' - interpreted as 115 sCh cases, 5 deaths. District subset of the 2006/2007 season - do not sum with JHU national 2006 annual row (5360). Single Level-2 source (100-1000 tier).
retracted_reason: Agent 1: misattribution found - IFRC final report sentence conflated two outbreaks; the original DREF Bulletin MDRZM003 (29 Nov 2006) shows the 115 cases/5 deaths were in Chienge (Luapula) as at 20 Nov 2006 while Kapiri Mposhi had 9 confirmed cases and no deaths. Replaced by new rows citing the bulletin.

source: IFRC DREF Operation MDRZM005 Final Report Zambia Cholera 2008-2009
processing_notes: Source states: 'The first cholera case was reported at the fishing camps in Mpulungu district of Northern Province. The outbreak later spread to the fishing camps in Mazabuka in Southern Province. In mid-January 2009, the cumulative number of confirmed cholera cases was 597 (538 in Lusaka, 40 in Mazabuka, and 19 in Livingstone).' - interpreted as 597 sCh cases. 2008/09 season cumulative from outbreak announcement (Nov 2008) to mid-January 2009 (TR set 2009-01-15). Source says 'confirmed'; recorded as total cases (sCh) because Zambian reporting of the period used 'confirmed' for the cumulative case count. Do not sum with JHU 2008/2009 national annual rows. National cumulative (sum of the three districts listed) - district rows from same sentence are subsets.
retracted_reason: Agent 1: the 597 in IFRC MDRZM005 is the sum of three districts (Lusaka 538, Mazabuka 40, Livingstone 19), not a national total - UN/MoH update of 7 Jan 2009 reports 1,536 national cases since 10 Sep 2008; a national row of 597 would understate national burden. District rows 61-63 retained.
